finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts::toggle-off now emits a yorkie `removestylebypath` op on the hottest editing path (b/i/u/s); if yorkie history cannot reverse treestyleremove, cmd+z after a toggle-off silently stops restoring the flag
evidence: The mechanism is accurately traced: `styleOffAsClear` (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:392-411) demotes toggle-off `false` to `undefined`, and `removedInlineStyleAttrs` (yorkie-doc-store.ts:~144) converts that into a `removeStyleByPath`, so the op mix on the hot path did change. But the claimed defect (undo silently failing) is explicitly conditional on unverified Yorkie SDK behavior — the reviewer could not confirm it and neither could I — and the same `removeStyleByPath` path was already exercised pre-change by clear-formatting (`CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE`) and `removeLink`, so any such undo breakage would predate this PR. No demonstrated defect in the code as written; this is a risk hypothesis, not a verified bug.
